verdict.rationale:
AnythingLLM offers admin-level permission controls and multi-user isolation (fine-grained admin controls, agent permission configuration in docs-6/docs-9), and it can be self-hosted via Docker (docs-8) which provides container-level isolation for the whole app. However there is no evidence of per-tool sandboxing, execution policies, or containment specifically for risky agent tool runs (e.g., restricting filesystem/network access per tool call).

missing for 10: dedicated tool-execution sandboxing (VM/container per agent action), documented tool allow/deny policies, and independent verification that agent tool runs are actually contained.
